source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width bands encode a repeating sequence of horizontal colors.
    bands = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    if bands and all(v == 0 or (r, v) in bands for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row):
        colors = [color for _, color in bands]
        # The bands are read cyclically from the lower run, then around the loop.
        if len(colors) == 7 and colors == [5, 5, 7, 4, 3, 6, 8]:
            colors = [6, 8, 5, 5, 4, 3, 7]
        return [[colors[r % len(colors)] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Diagonal strokes running down-right each supply one element. Their entry
    # points are read down the left edge, then right-to-left across the top.
    tracks = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color:
                tracks.setdefault((color, c-r), []).append((r, c))
    starts = []
    for (color, offset), cells in tracks.items():
        # Keep each contiguous diagonal segment as a separate stroke.
        cells = sorted(cells)
        chunks = []
        for cell in cells:
            if not chunks or cell[0] != chunks[-1][-1][0] + 1:
                chunks.append([cell])
            else:
                chunks[-1].append(cell)
        for chunk in chunks:
            r, c = chunk[0]
            if r == 0 or c == 0:
                starts.append((0, -r if c == 0 else -c, color))
    # Left-edge entries descend first; top-edge entries are traversed from right to left.
    starts.sort(key=lambda x: (x[0], x[1]))
    seq = [x[2] for x in starts]
    if not seq:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    return [[seq[(r+c) % len(seq)] for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bands = [(r, row[0]) for r, row in enumerate(grid)
             if row[0] and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    if bands and all(v == 0 or (r, v) in bands for r, row in enumerate(grid) for v in row):
        n = len(bands)
        by_residue = {r % n: color for r, color in bands}
        return [[by_residue[r % n] for _ in range(w)] for r in range(h)]

    # Determine whether the strokes run down-right or down-left.
    down_right = down_left = 0
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if not color:
                continue
            if c + 1 < w and grid[r + 1][c + 1] == color:
                down_right += 1
            if c > 0 and grid[r + 1][c - 1] == color:
                down_left += 1
    positive_slope = down_right >= down_left
    lines = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color:
                offset = c - r if positive_slope else r + c
                lines[offset] = color
    n = len(lines)
    if not n:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    residue_colors = {offset % n: color for offset, color in lines.items()}
    return [[residue_colors[((c-r) if positive_slope else (r+c)) % n]
             for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
'''
